explanation: The theorem says that substituting power series with zero constant coefficient into an MvPowerSeries preserves the constant coefficient. I searched Mathlib for `constantCoeff`/`subst` lemmas. Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Substitution.lean has `MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff_subst`, which is the general finsum formula. This is what the proof uses. It also has `constantCoeff_subst_eq_zero`, which only gives the conclusion `= 0` when the constant coefficient of `f` is also zero. Mathlib/RingTheory/PowerSeries/Substitution.lean has analogues for univariate `f`. None of these states `constantCoeff (subst a f) = constantCoeff f` for `a` with zero constant coefficients. Getting it from `constantCoeff_subst` takes the `finsum_eq_single` argument the proof already makes, so it is not a one- or two-line derivation.
